Who we are

SKY TRADING is a focused trading education and mentorship community built around discipline, clarity and execution. We aim to help traders develop a structured way of reading the market, managing risk and reviewing their decisions.

Our approach is process-first: understand the context, wait for the right conditions, execute according to a plan and continuously improve through review. The goal is to build skills and decision-making—not dependence on hype or unrealistic promises.

DisciplineFollow a defined process instead of reacting emotionally.
ClarityReduce noise and focus on the information that matters.
Risk FirstProtect capital and treat risk management as part of the edge.
Continuous GrowthReview, learn and improve as your trading develops.

Support & FAQ

Frequently asked
questions.

Everything you need to know about the mentorship structure, duration and support available at SKY TRADING.

How much duration is the course?
It generally takes 4–5 months for intermediate traders to cover all the required concepts and other essential things. For pure beginners, the duration completely depends on the individual and their learning pace. Irrespective of the time it takes, we are always here to support you throughout your trading career, so you do not have to worry about the mentorship having a validity period or expiry.
What mentorship programmes do you provide?
We provide two mentorship programmes: Group Session Mentorship and One-to-One Mentorship.
How often are group mentorship classes conducted?
Group mentorship classes are conducted 3–4 times a week. You can also ask your queries in the group chat and during the Saturday and Sunday classes.
How does one-to-one mentorship work?
One-to-one sessions are scheduled according to the individual's availability. We adjust the sessions around the time that works for you, while providing 24/7 support for your queries.
Is sudden support through a call available in group mentorship?
Group mentorship does not include sudden query support through calls. Queries can be asked in the group chat and during the Saturday and Sunday classes. One-to-one mentorship includes 24/7 query support.
